detailed_description: The Grouped Bar Chart Generator helps you compare several series side by side within the same category. It is a practical choice for showing differences across teams, regions, plans, or time periods when viewers need clear one-to-one comparisons. You can enter grouped values, adjust titles, legends, colors, and spacing, then preview the result in the browser before exporting it as PNG or SVG for reports, decks, or dashboard mockups.
usage_steps: Add category labels and the grouped values you want to compare in the chart editor.
Set the chart title and series names so each cluster is easy to interpret.
Adjust colors, legend visibility, and spacing to keep the grouped bars readable.
Review the preview and refine labels or values if any category feels crowded.
Export the grouped bar chart as PNG or SVG once the comparison is presentation-ready.
usage_examples: Compare quarterly revenue across product lines within each region.
Show survey results by audience segment for the same set of questions.
Present monthly performance by channel so stakeholders can compare categories side by side.
